UFO 50 for Analogue Pocket (work in progress) - namdl0

A port of the UFO 50 runtime to the Analogue Pocket openFPGA platform.

Version 0.0.1 (milestone M1) only shows a 384x216 video test pattern:
colour bars, a grey ramp, checkerboards, a white border on the outermost
pixels with a red ring inside it, and a bouncing box.
  A held      : box turns cyan
  B held      : box freezes
  Select held : greyscale
  Start held  : inverted colours

No game files are needed or loaded yet. Later versions will read files
converted from your own copy of UFO 50; none are distributed with this core.

UFO 50 is (c) Mossmouth. This is an unofficial fan project.
